title: Accuracy Is Not Service: A Decision-Aware Benchmark for Intermittent-Demand Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.13840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A contract-logistics spare-parts operator is paid on order-level service: an order counts only if every requested line is fulfilled, yet forecasters are selected based on line-level forecast accuracy. This disconnect matters when demand is intermittent and lumpy, histories are short, and lead times span months. We benchmarked 38 forecasting methods spanning classical, intermittent-demand, machine-learning, deep-learning, and pretrained foundation models. A common decision-aware protocol evaluates them on an industrial panel drawn from a live contract and two public datasets. Forecast-accuracy rank and order-service rank are negatively correlated on the industrial panel, at -0.555, across methods evaluated on 20,330 real multi-item orders. Service is more closely associated with the direction of cumulative forecast bias, including over-prediction during zero-demand periods, than with point accuracy. Examining bias in Chronos-2's instance

translated_title: 准确率不等于服务：面向间歇性需求预测的决策感知基准测试
translated_abstract: 合同物流备件运营商的报酬基于订单级服务：只有当订单中所有请求的行项目都被满足时，该订单才算完成，然而预测模型却是基于行级预测准确率来选择的。当需求呈现间歇性和块状特征、历史数据较短、交货期长达数月时，这种脱节尤为关键。我们对涵盖经典方法、间歇性需求方法、机器学习、深度学习以及预训练基础模型的38种预测方法进行了基准测试。采用统一的决策感知协议，在一个来自实际运营合同的工业数据面板和两个公开数据集上对它们进行评估。在工业面板上，基于20,330个真实多商品订单对各方法进行评估后发现，预测准确率排名与订单服务排名呈负相关，相关系数为-0.555。服务表现与累积预测偏差方向（包括零需求期间的过度预测）的关联，比与点预测准确率的关联更为密切。通过考察Chronos-2实例中的偏差…
tldr: 本研究提出一个决策感知的间歇性需求预测基准，发现预测准确率排名与订单服务排名呈负相关（-0.555），服务表现更多取决于累积预测偏差的方向而非点预测准确率。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a decision-aware benchmark for intermittent-demand forecasting, revealing that forecast-accuracy rank is negatively correlated with order-service rank (-0.555), and that service performance is more closely associated with the direction of cumulative forecast bias than with point accuracy.
